reviews.text: I felt relieved after receiving such a thorough examination.

We keep a hamster as a pet, and before visiting your clinic, I checked your website and made an appointment for a veterinarian who was listed as being able to treat hamsters.

However, I later received a phone call informing me that "there are no veterinarians who can treat hamsters," "we cannot see hamsters at our clinic," and "we are fully booked and cannot accommodate you."

I checked the website again, thinking that the discrepancy between the website information and the actual service provided might be my own oversight, but the day I made the appointment was indeed a working day for a veterinarian listed as being able to treat hamsters. Therefore, I have serious doubts about the discrepancy between the website information and the actual service provided.

Furthermore, I cannot understand why I was refused treatment despite having already made a reservation, citing "fully booked appointments." If there were circumstances preventing treatment, shouldn't the reservation have not been accepted in the first place?

If there was a duplicate reservation, I believe an explanation should be given as to why the reservation was duplicated and why my appointment had to be refused.

Small animals have fewer hospitals compared to dogs and cats, and whether or not they can receive treatment can be a matter of life and death. As a pet owner who made a reservation believing that treatment was possible, being told that they could not actually see my pet was extremely worrying and burdensome.

I made my reservation based on high customer reviews and trust, so I am extremely disappointed with the way this was handled.

The information on the types of animals treated and the services offered by veterinarians listed on the website is an important factor for patients when choosing a hospital. If the information is inaccurate, it should be corrected immediately. Furthermore, I would like to request that you provide accurate information regarding animals that cannot be treated and the reservation status, and that you thoroughly implement appropriate reservation management to avoid misunderstandings.

I'm taking my cat to this clinic for treatment. Even with an appointment, there's often a long wait, but the doctor and staff are incredibly kind and attentive. The waiting room isn't small, but because there are so many people waiting, I usually leave while my cat is having blood tests. I come back when I have a chance, but even then, there's often a long wait, so I selfishly wish they'd send a message via LINE saying something like, "We'll be finished soon." 🙂‍↕️

I had my cat treated for FIP at this hospital, and I truly feel like it saved her. Their medical approach and knowledge are extensive, they listen attentively to what you have to say, and they provide thorough advice on all your concerns. I highly recommend them not only as your regular vet, but also for a second opinion.

The other day, I took my dog ​​to the vet, and they found a lump in one of its lymph nodes. They said it was highly likely to be malignant and that it would be best to take a biopsy to diagnose it. I agreed and waited for the results at the clinic, but they couldn't get a proper biopsy. They told me that if I left my dog ​​with them until 5 pm, they would be able to give me a proper result. I left my dog ​​there and went back at 5 pm to get the results, but they said they still couldn't get a proper biopsy and couldn't make a diagnosis. They also said that if it was malignant, they would normally be able to get a proper biopsy, so it was probably nothing to worry about. When I got home and did some research, I found that there's no truth to the idea that if they can't get a proper biopsy, it's not malignant. I called later to ask for the test results, and they said it would cost 3,000 yen. On the day of the visit, I paid over 24,000 yen for the follow-up consultation, X-ray, and biopsy, and then they said it would cost an additional 3,000 yen to get the results. I was honestly speechless. When I called and told them that I didn't understand why I had come in the first place, they said that they hadn't explained things well this time and would give me the diagnosis results free of charge this time only. Later, when I went to pick them up at the designated time (noon), the hospital was closed. When I called, I was told that the clinic was only open until noon, so why did the veterinarian ask me to come pick up my pet at noon? Perhaps the veterinarian I happened to see was incompetent, but this experience is very disappointing, and I'm not sure what the point of my visit was.

My cat was in critical condition, so I visited right before opening hours, but they were very kind and patient with me. They explained things to me repeatedly with precise and easy-to-understand explanations, which helped calm me down even though I was in a state of panic. Unfortunately, my cat passed away the next day, but without the care they provided, I don't think our whole family would have been able to be there until the end. Thank you very much.

We've been using Dr. Yamamoto's services for about a year now; he's our primary veterinarian and treats our two cats.

Dr. Yamamoto specializes in dentistry, and I asked him to perform a dental cleaning on our 4-year-old cat. He meticulously prepared post-operative follow-up reports, and her yellowed teeth were sparkling clean!

I was concerned about general anesthesia, but our cat was very energetic at home. Since she's getting older, we want to do everything we can to prevent future problems, so I'm very satisfied with the results and will continue to consider future check-ups.

We're also members of the Wellness Club and receive monthly care and check-ups. We also have a cat with feline asthma, and Dr. Yamamoto is working closely with us on her treatment. I feel like her asthma is steadily improving!

Dr. Yamamoto is always attentive to the owner and treats the cats with kindness, which is very clear. I look forward to going to the hospital every month to check on their weight and condition with the doctor.

We hope to continue entrusting our two cats to your care. Thank you to the nurses and everyone else for your constant care and consideration!

I had my cat examined at Momoi Animal Hospital, recommended by my regular veterinarian at another animal hospital. The hospital was bright and the female staff were very kind and attentive, which put me at ease despite my initial anxiety. Most importantly, the doctor's explanations were clear and easy to understand, and the test results were good, so I'm really glad I had my cat examined at Momoi Animal Hospital. Thank you very much.

I came to your clinic for a second opinion after the heart disease diagnosis at another hospital was difficult to understand. 

My dog ​​doesn't like hospitals, so I was very grateful that they finished the examination in about an hour and allowed me to go home with him. 

They said, "Since this is your first visit, please take the time to explain things in detail," so I returned alone in the evening, and they explained the current situation in a way that was easy to understand. 

It was still painful to be diagnosed with heart disease and pulmonary hypertension, but I felt a lot better when they explained to me that it wasn't as serious as the diagnosis at the other hospital and gave me a clear plan for what to do next. 

I will continue to monitor my dog's condition closely and do my best to ensure that he lives a comfortable life. 

I look forward to your continued support.
